bio: Dr. Ajoy Kapat received his B.Sc. in Chemistry (Honours) from the University of Calcutta and his M.Sc. from the Indian Institute of Technology Madras, before earning his PhD in Organic Chemistry from the University of Bern, Switzerland, in 2011.

Following postdoctoral appointments at Princeton University and RWTH Aachen University, and a research position at the Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science, he began his independent career in 2019 as Assistant Professor in the Department of Chemistry, School of Natural Science, Shiv Nadar University — where his group develops asymmetric, cascade and metalloradical catalysis.
